events.title: HIMMELSDUFT
events.description:
@

HIMMELSDUFT’ is an evening of experimental sound, scent and collected objects at PAS Berlin, set by the Spree where the river divides Moabit and Charlottenburg.

The event begins at 16:00 inside the PAS artist residence with a pop-up by Berlin-based fine fragrance brand smth’ and free entry until 20:30. Visitors are invited to explore scent, designed objects and the artists’ own environment.

At 18:00, the musical program moves outside for an open-air concert by the Spree. The event opens with atmospheric, trappy and downtempo sounds from 990 X and Pead Rasanon.

As daylight fades, MARGGREAT brings a house-driven transition between the outdoor session and the indoor part of the night, shifting the atmosphere from open-air warmth into deeper rhythmic movement.

After sunset, the gathering returns inside the PAS artist residence for the indoor part of the night, where the sound moves further into deeper rhythms and groovy techno with Daviti and SSXXCH.

events.title: Circle live show + support Zebra&Friends
events.description:
@

Circle, a Berlin-based rock project, is taking its living-room-style gigs to the next level: a full concert with professional sound!

Come dance, sing along, and get nostalgic with the songs we all know by heart. It’s also a chance to meet the Circle community: people from different countries who love letting loose to this music just as much as you do.

In one summer evening, we’ll play everything: from the MTV era and Shrek OST to Soviet pop diva Alla Pugacheva and viral Reels tracks reimagined in punk-rock.

We’ve prepared a new live set, kept a couple of crowd favorites that tore up the dance floor last time, and at the end of the night we’ll premiere our new original song.

Our friends from “Zebra&Friends” will open the night.
___________________________

📍 PAS Berlin
First Floor, Hinterhof Aufgang II
Kaiserin-Augusta-Allee 101, Berlin

📅 Friday, June 19, 2026
🕗 Doors open: 19:00

🎟 Online pre-sale: 15 €
🎟 At the door: 20 €
🚫 No outside drinks allowed.

TICKETS

Музыкальный проект Circle расширяет свои берлинские квартирники до концерта с профессиональным звуком!

Приходи поколбаситься и поностальгировать под любимую классику. А ещё – познакомиться с Circle-коммьюнити – ребятами из разных стран, которые так же любят отрываться под эту музыку.
За один летний вечер мы сыграем всё: от музыки эпохи MTV и саундтреков к «Шреку» до Аллы Борисовны и треков из рилсов в панк-обработке.

Мы подготовили новую программу, сохранив пару хитов, разорвавших танцпол в прошлый раз. А в конце представим свою новую песню.

Вечер откроют наши друзья из группы “Zebra&Friends”

events.title: Slightly Imperfect – Songs of Ivor Cutler
events.description:
@

Greg Malcolm – Guitar / Voice
Jenny Ward – Electronics / Voice / Laughing Box
Michael Griener – Drums
Dan Peter Sundland -Electric bass

Slightly Imperfect by New Zealand duo is a sojourn into the strange world of Scottish poet, writer and songwriter Ivor Cutler. The songs and poems are placed in a surreal and gentle playground of laughing boxes, toys, whirring pipes and theatrical elements to create an enchanting performance. Incorporating domestic objects and dance, silence and sound, text and extended techniques, participants are drawn into a timeless realm, an ode to play, and absurdity.

events.title: PAS Berlin at ZK/U OPENHAUS event
events.description:
@

PAS Showcase at ZK/U OPENHAUS event
Thursday, September 24 / Main Hall 19:00 – 21:00
at ZK/U Siemensstr. 27, 10551 Berlin

Program:
Mika Tzur: A solo dance work “At Least I Walk”
Tomas Stary: exhibition and presentation of works
Alexander Markvart: solo feedback acoustic guitar & objects improvised set
Adrien Vel: Animated movie “AUFGANG II” 2024 Film-essai / documentary / animation digital – color

more info:

Mika Tzur
A solo dance work taking place in an underground parking garage, laden with references to Dutch Gabber music and Japanese Butoh dance. I came to my artistic exploration with the question – “How can one dance after trauma?” focused on the physical and emotional mechanisms involved. The work expresses the courage and loneliness associated with the choice of life and the intensity of the traumatic space between ecstasy and hell. The work was created as a part of my 4th yeart studies at the School of visual theater. The work was presented in the Pyramid culture center, Haifa, 2024. Choreographer & Performer: Mika Tzur
https://mikatzur9.wixsite.com/mika-tzur-dance

Tomas Stary (*1994) is a Czech visual artist and freelance digital designer based in Prague who delves into the exploration and expansion of typography, drawing inspiration from graffiti aesthetics. Since 2010, he has been active in the art scene, leaving his mark around the world in more than 15 countries, taking a part in renowned street art fairs. in 2020, Tomas graduated from a design university, which, along with his graffiti roots, forms a foundational pillar of his artistic aesthetics. Minimalism not only defines his visuals but also represents his personal life philosophy and state of mind.
https://tomasstary.com/

Alexander Markvart – is a musician, member of theater projects and organizer of events and festivals. Born on January 5, 1987 in Kemerovo. Now based in Berlin. He is a notable figure on the Russian new improvised and experimental music scenes. Founder of such polystylistic musical formations as Studio of Unconscious Music (SUM) and Siberian Improvisation Company (SIC!). Also in different years is a member of another experimental bands and projects – Sacrifices, Verevka, Radical Muzak Septet, MITLO, Klub Demboh, Inorganic Blossoming, PSVSV, Cherubs, Importunate Twins, Sekta Phoenix, RAFGAK. Works and plays concerts in various projects with different musicians from all other the world. Since 2011, Alexander actively plays concerts in different tours in Europe, Russia and USA, participant of different international festivals in Russia and EU. Organizer of festivals and concerts in Siberia, St.Petersburg and Berlin. The most significant of which is the festival of different arts “Theses Fest”. Site editor of vovne.art. Since 2018 main artistic director of PAS Berlin (Petersburg Art Space Berlin). Also run such places in St.Petersburg as Folly Bar, Art-Farm 36, F5 / Noisegraph.
bandcamp: https://alexandermarkvart.bandcamp.com/

Adrien Vel
AUFGANG II
Berlin, 2023. I have to spend two month in an artistic residency nestled in an old industrial building in the north west of the city. I decided to do an experience that requires being in an unknown city. The idea was to start from a precise point and move at random, intuitively, on foot or by public transport, until i get completely lost. I wanted to know where my intuition would take me in an unknown environment. I also wanted to go in search of synchronicity, in search of a correspondance between my personal life and external reality. I tried to show that life can also be read like a dream.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O_FLlcaeEh8
https://adrienvel.fr/
